layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#DADCE0] rounded-md shadow-sm overflow-hidden
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid: use tight gaps (gap-4) for data-heavy sections. Maximize vertical space.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align text and forms; center-align hero upload card; right-align numeric data in tables.

component_instructions.sidebar: Fixed left navigation. Light grey background (#F8F9FA) with a 1px right border (#DADCE0). Highlight active route with #E8F0FE background and #1A73E8 text.
component_instructions.hero_upload_portal: Centrally aligned card. Max width 2xl. Distinct drag-and-drop zone with a dashed border (#DADCE0). On drag over, change bg to #E8F0FE. Must resemble a GCP 'Create Resource' form.
component_instructions.attribute_config_grid: Dense data table format. Row per attribute (Name, Phone, City). Columns: Attribute Name, Survivorship Intent (textarea with h-16 text-sm border-gray-300), Match Type (Toggle: Deterministic/Probabilistic), Weightage (Slider + Numeric Input side-by-side, max-w-[200px]).
component_instructions.strategy_summary_panel: Plain English agent confirmation. Style as an 'Info Callout' box: border-l-4 border-[#1A73E8], bg-[#E8F0FE], text-[#1557B0]. Include a 'Confirm & Execute' button.
component_instructions.pipeline_visualization: Horizontal node sequence (GCS -> Raw -> Staging -> Curated). Use simple rectangular cards connected by chevron arrows. Active/Completed nodes in green (#188038), Pending in gray (#5F6368).
component_instructions.results_tables: Material Design 3 styled tables. Sticky headers. First column pinned. Right-align numeric columns like 'Suspect Score'. Use Shadcn table but override to dense padding (py-2 px-4).
component_instructions.sql_viewer: Monospace text block. Dark theme (bg-[#202124], text-white) to create contrast against the light UI, matching IDE/Cloud Shell vibes. Include a 'Copy to Clipboard' button.
component_instructions.buttons: Flat and functional. Primary buttons: bg-[#1A73E8] text-white hover:bg-[#1557B0] hover:shadow-md transition-all. Secondary: border border-[#DADCE0] text-[#1A73E8] hover:bg-[#E8F0FE].

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Rows in tables should have hover:bg-[#F8F9FA]. Buttons should subtly lift or darken.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: All inputs and buttons MUST have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1A73E8] focus:outline-none.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-colors duration-200 for buttons and links.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='upload-submit-button'.
accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum contrast for text. Use text-[#202124] over #FFFFFF or #F8F9FA.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (or @phosphor-icons/react if preferred for technical look). Command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
